tags.name: Transactional Email
tags.description: Configure per-realm transactional email provider routing

get.description: Returns the current provider, template mappings, and provider-specific config. Sensitive values (API keys) are masked as "**secret**".

put.description: Stores provider, template mappings, and provider config as realm attributes. providerConfig values equal to "**secret**" are ignored to allow safe round-tripping. Set provider to empty string to disable transactional routing.

delete.description: Removes all _providerConfig.ext-email-template.* realm attributes, disabling transactional routing for all email types.

get.summary: List supported email types and their template variables
get.description: Returns all Keycloak email types this extension supports, with the dynamic template variables available for each. Use this as a reference when designing templates in your provider's editor. All types also receive the universal base variables: realmName, userEmail, userFirstName, userLastName, username.

provider.description: ID of the active TransactionalEmailProvider (e.g. 'sendgrid'). Empty or null disables transactional routing for all email types.

additionalProperties.description: Maps Keycloak email-type names to provider-specific template IDs. Only mapped types are routed externally; others fall back to FreeMarker + SMTP.

templates.description: Maps Keycloak email-type names to provider-specific template IDs. Only mapped types are routed externally; others fall back to FreeMarker + SMTP.

additionalProperties.description: Provider-specific configuration keyed as '<providerId>.<key>' (e.g. 'sendgrid.api-key'). Sensitive values are masked as '**secret**' in GET responses; send the real value on PUT to update, or omit entirely to preserve the stored value.

providerConfig.description: Provider-specific configuration keyed as '<providerId>.<key>' (e.g. 'sendgrid.api-key'). Sensitive values are masked as '**secret**' in GET responses; send the real value on PUT to update, or omit entirely to preserve the stored value.

TransactionalEmailConfig.description: Transactional email configuration for a realm

name.description: Keycloak email type name, used as the key in the templates map

description.description: Human-readable description of when this email is sent

variables.description: Variables available to the dynamic template for this email type. Every type also receives the universal base variables (realmName, userEmail, etc.)

items.description: Variables available to the dynamic template for this email type. Every type also receives the universal base variables (realmName, userEmail, etc.)

TemplateInfo.description: Metadata about a Keycloak email type and the template variables it exposes
